C-PLANS-COMPACT-TOOLBAR-259.IntentSummary: Deliver one coherent designer-led plans toolbar vertical: persistent lifecycle navigation, progressive disclosure for rare filters, readable filter tokens and stale-response-safe list/detail updates.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: lock the real plans toolbar state model

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Lifecycle, search, rare filters, selection, empty, loading and stale-response states have one deterministic transition model.
The primary path is open plans → find or filter → select plan, with one-action current/archive navigation and no confirmation step.
Archive/restore commands remain separate never-learn actions and do not become list navigation.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: adapt proven toolbar, segment and disclosure semantics

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Design evidence records exact Docomator and Planer Solving commits and maps only reusable interaction semantics, not copied code or assets.
The hierarchy is search + persistent lifecycle segment + one filter disclosure; active conditions remain legible as tokens.
Desktop 1440×900, constrained desktop 1024×768, mobile 390×844 and 200 percent zoom preserve stable geometry, 44 px targets and no horizontal spill.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: define restrained segment, disclosure and token feedback

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Selection and disclosure use only interruptible 120–220 ms state transitions; no data operation waits for animation.
Token removal uses local opacity feedback only and does not animate list geometry.
prefers-reduced-motion makes selection and disclosure immediate while preserving focus and state semantics.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data: preserve the existing query and lifecycle authority

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No schema or migration changes occur; the plans API query remains authoritative.
Lifecycle-safe archive/restore hands navigation back to the plans controller rather than rewriting GET requests in a second layer.
Repeated control changes are idempotent, and request sequence ids prevent stale projection replacement.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement the coherent toolbar vertical in the real plans screen

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The existing plans UI renders the segment, search, compact panel, counter, tokens and precise reset without a heuristic DOM enhancer.
Existing kind, period, direction, responsible and status parameters drive one server request path and valid context survives.
Keyboard, focus return, outside click, Escape, empty states and stale list/detail handling are complete.

T-006.Title: kafedra-design-audit: independently inspect actual desktop, constrained and mobile behavior

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The audit uses the actual plans screen and records pass or actionable findings for hierarchy, overflow, keyboard, focus, contrast, 200 percent zoom and prefers-reduced-motion.
No blocker or major finding remains unresolved; the audit confirms reference patterns were adapted rather than copied.

T-007.Title: kafedra-tests: prove the real toolbar user flow and regression boundaries

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit tests prove one lifecycle authority, rare-filter-only reset, tokens, accessibility semantics, no persistence and stale-response guards.
Playwright exercises the actual plans view for lifecycle, search, disclosure, tokens, Escape/focus, precise empty states, constrained/mobile overflow and reduced motion.
Existing plans, lifecycle and full project tests remain green.

T-008.Title: kafedra-release: complete exact-head CI, squash merge and terminal archive

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: GRACE final, project, browser, release, offline and database gates succeed on one unchanged PR head.
The implementation is squash-merged only after exact-head, mergeability and review-thread checks.
Successful post-merge CI precedes a separate archive-only PR that moves this complete bundle to status applied.
